entries.text: Paul Bunyan and Babe the Big Blue Ox live in Montana now, where Paul is working on painting the big sky blue over the clouds that roll in so that the rest of the United States will be blessed with big blue skies. Sometimes he sleeps or gets distracted and this is when we get clouds and rain.
